notes.title: An Important Launch Update for Stellar Dream
notes.notes:
To our dedicated fans and followers,



Thank you for the incredible enthusiasm and support you’ve shown for Stellar Dream. Your excitement is what drives us to create a deep, compelling world filled with the mature, narrative-driven experience we promised.



We’re writing to you today with an important update on our launch plan.



As some of you may know, Steam has recently updated its rules and policies regarding Adult Only content within its Early Access program. In light of these new guidelines, and to ensure a smooth, guaranteed release for all our players, we have made the decision to pivot our launch strategy.



Stellar Dream will no longer be released in Early Access. Instead, we will be launching the game as Stellar Dream - Part 1.



This means that on release day, you will get a satisfying game with an intriguing narrative arc. It will contain a lot of the features we planned so far and the second part will expand on it.



The grand, overarching saga of Stellar Dream remains our ultimate goal. The remainder of the story will be released in the second part. This new structure allows us to continue developing the full, uncompromising story we've always envisioned while successfully navigating the new platform requirements.



We are completely committed to delivering the entire epic tale of Stellar Dream, with all of its intricate plotlines and intimate moments. This adjustment simply changes the way we'll be delivering the journey to you.



Thank you for your understanding. Your support means everything to us. Please keep Stellar Dream - Part 1 on your Wishlist to be notified the moment it launches.



Best regards,



Winterlook Games.
